records.jp: しほり！　ちょっとしっかりして！<CR>落ち着いて！
records.en_original: Shihori! Pull yourself together! Calm down!
records.en_auxiliary: Shihori! Pull yourself together! Calm down!
records.en: Shihori! Pull yourself together!<CR>Calm down!

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん……はあ…はぁ…………
records.en_original: Hinako... Haah... Haah...
records.en_auxiliary: *Pant* Hinako...
records.en: Hinako-chan... *Pant*... *Pant*...

records.jp: 私、日菜子ちゃんを見てたら<CR>なんか変な気持ちになっちゃって……
records.en_original: When I was looking at you, something strange just came over me...
records.en_auxiliary: When I was looking at you, something strange just came over me.
records.en: When I looked at you, Hinako-chan,<CR>I started feeling strange...

records.jp: どうして今日に限って？　私を見る機会なんていくらでもあったのに……
records.en_original: Why today in particular? You've looked at me plenty of other times...
records.en_auxiliary: Why today in particular? You've looked at me plenty of other times.
records.en: Why only today? You've had plenty of chances to look at me before...

records.jp: なんでだろ？　日菜子ちゃんと二人っきりになれたからかな……
records.en_original: I don't know? Maybe it's because we were alone together like this...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know. Maybe it's because we were alone together like this.
records.en: I wonder why. Maybe because I finally got to be alone with you, Hinako-chan...

records.jp: それとも、日菜子ちゃんと下着交換した直後だったからかな……
records.en_original: Or maybe it's because we had just swapped underwear...
records.en_auxiliary: Or maybe it's because we had just swapped underwear.
records.en: Or because it was right after I swapped underwear with you...

records.jp: （それだけで暴走するとは思えないけど……）
records.en_original: (I don't think that's enough to go rampant over...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I don't think that's enough to go rampant over.)
records.en: (I don't think that alone would be enough to make her Fragment run rampant...)

records.jp: うーん……あと、たぶん……<CR>この前話したデザイナーの人のことを思い出してたからかも……
records.en_original: Hmm... Also, I think... It's because I started remembering the designer I talked about before...
records.en_auxiliary: Also, I think... It's because I started remembering the designer I talked about before.
records.en: Hmm... And maybe...<CR>because I was remembering the designer I told you about...

records.jp: ん……？　どういうこと……？
records.en_original: Huh...? What do you mean...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Why would that matter?
records.en: Huh...? What do you mean...?

records.jp: さっきの日菜子ちゃんの着替え、しぐさとかがその人にそっくりで<CR>ホントに昔に戻ったみたいに感じてたから……
records.en_original: While you were changing, your movements were just like her. It felt like I had gone back to the past...
records.en_auxiliary: While you were changing, your movements were just like hers. It felt like I had gone back to the past.
records.en: The way you moved while changing earlier was exactly like her,<CR>so it felt as though I'd gone back in time...

records.jp: ヒナちゃんお待たせ―……
records.en_original: Sorry for the wait, Hina-chan...
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry for the wait, Hina.
records.en: Hina-chan, sorry to keep you waiting—

records.jp: 二人とも大丈夫？　って何でそんなかっこうしてるの？
records.en_original: Are you two okay? Wait, what happened to your clothes?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you two okay? What happened to your clothes?
records.en: Are you both okay? Wait, why are you dressed like that?

records.jp: ユズ、ライム……これは……あの……その……
records.en_original: Yuzu, Lime... This is... Um... We...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu, Lime... This is... Um... We...
records.en: Yuzu, Lime... This is... Um... Well...

records.jp: 二人とも……そういう関係だったのね……
records.en_original: So you two... Are in that kind of relationship...
records.en_auxiliary: So you two... are in that kind of relationship.
records.en: So the two of you...have that kind of relationship...

records.jp: 知らなかったよー……
records.en_original: We didn't know...
records.en_auxiliary: We didn't know—
records.en: We had no idea...

records.jp: ち、違う！<CR>これはちょっと色々あって……
records.en_original: Th-That's not it! I can explain...!
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that's not it! I can explain!
records.en: Th-That's not it!<CR>A lot happened, and...

records.jp: 色々……？
records.en_original: Can you...?
records.en_auxiliary: Can you?
records.en: A lot...?

records.jp: うーん……どう説明しよう……
records.en_original: Um... Oh, where do I start...?
records.en_auxiliary: Well... Oh, where do I start?
records.en: Hmm... How am I supposed to explain this...?

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん、私が説明するよ。<CR>実は……
records.en_original: Hinako, I'll explain it. To tell the truth...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako, I'll explain it. To tell the truth...
records.en: Hinako-chan, I'll explain.<CR>Actually...

records.jp: へえ、しほちゃんて結構大胆なんだね……？
records.en_original: Huh, you're pretty bold, Shiho-chan...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, you're pretty bold, Shiho...
records.en: Wow, Shiho-chan. You're pretty bold, aren't you...?

records.jp: へへへ……
records.en_original: Hehehe...
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe!
records.en: Hehehe...

records.jp: いや、別に褒めてないと思う……
records.en_original: I wouldn't take that as a compliment.
records.en_auxiliary: I wouldn't take that as a compliment.
records.en: I don't think she was complimenting you...

records.jp: ところで、しほちゃん、そのデザイナーさんてどんな人？<CR>ユズたちでも知ってるかな？
records.en_original: By the way, what kind of person was that designer? Would we know her?
records.en_auxiliary: By the way, what kind of person was that designer? Would we know her?
records.en: By the way, Shiho-chan, what kind of person is that designer?<CR>Would we know her?

records.jp: えーと……ＹＯＳＨＩＫＯさんて人なんだけど、<CR>今はイタリアを中心に活動してて
records.en_original: Um... She went by the name YOSHIKO, and she currently works out of Italy.
records.en_auxiliary: Um... She went by the name YOSHIKO, and she currently works out of Italy.
records.en: Um... Her name is YOSHIKO-san.<CR>She mainly works in Italy now.

records.jp: ドロウハーツってブランドを立ち上げた人
records.en_original: She started a brand called Draw Hearts.
records.en_auxiliary: She started a brand called Draw Hearts.
records.en: She's the founder of the brand Draw Hearts.

records.jp: その人知ってる！　超有名人じゃん！<CR>ねえ、ライム！
records.en_original: We know that name! She's super famous! Right, Lime!?
records.en_auxiliary: We know that name! She's super famous! Right, Lime?!
records.en: I know her! She's incredibly famous!<CR>Right, Lime!?

records.jp: うん……。というかライムもその人がデザインした服持ってる。<CR>ヒナちゃんも名前くらいは聞いたことあるんじゃない？
records.en_original: Yeah... In fact, I have clothes designed by her. I'm sure you've at least heard her name too, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! In fact, I have clothes designed by her. I'm sure you've at least heard her name too, Hina.
records.en: Yeah... Lime owns some clothes she designed too.<CR>You've probably at least heard her name, Hina-chan, haven't you?

records.jp: ヒナちゃん……どうかした……？<CR>黙っちゃって……
records.en_original: Hina... What's wrong...? You've gone quiet...
records.en_auxiliary: Hina? What's wrong? Why are you being so quiet?
records.en: Hina-chan... What's wrong?<CR>You've gone quiet...

records.jp: おばさん……
records.en_original: My aunt...
records.en_auxiliary: My aunt...
records.en: My aunt...

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: その人……私のおばさん……
records.en_original: She's...my aunt...
records.en_auxiliary: She's... my aunt.
records.en: That woman...is my aunt...

records.jp: え、えー！
records.en_original: Wh-What!?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what?!
records.en: Wh-What!?

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん！　それホント！？
records.en_original: Hinako! Are you serious!?
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako! Are you serious?!
records.en: Hinako-chan! Is that true!?

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yup.
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: （まさかしほりをオシャレ好きにした人が<CR>良子おばさんだったなんて……）
records.en_original: (To think Aunt Yoshiko was the one who got Shihori into fashion...)
records.en_auxiliary: (To think, Aunt Yoshiko was the one who got Shihori into fashion.)
records.en: (I can't believe Aunt Yoshiko was the one<CR>who made Shihori love fashion...)

records.jp: すごーい！　まさか日菜子ちゃんが<CR>ＹＯＳＨＩＫＯさんの姪だったなんて！
records.en_original: That's amazing! To think you were the niece of YOSHIKO!
records.en_auxiliary: That's amazing! What are the odds that you'd be the niece of YOSHIKO?!
records.en: That's amazing! I can't believe you're<CR>YOSHIKO-san's niece, Hinako-chan!

records.jp: これは、運命だよ！　きっと神様がめぐり合わせてくれたんだよ！
records.en_original: This must be fate! I'm sure God brought us together!
records.en_auxiliary: This must be fate! I'm sure God brought us together!
records.en: This is fate! God must have brought us together!

records.jp: （やばっ！　カミングアウトしないほうが良かったかも……）
records.en_original: (Oh crap! Maybe I shouldn't have said anything...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh crap! Maybe I shouldn't have said anything.)
records.en: (Oh no! Maybe I shouldn't have told her...)

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃんもそう思わない？
records.en_original: Don't you agree, Hinako?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't you agree, Hinako?
records.en: Don't you think so too, Hinako-chan?

records.jp: え、うーんと……珍しいことだとは思う……
records.en_original: Huh, um... It's certainly unusual...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, um... It's certainly a heck of a coincidence.
records.en: W-Well... I do think it's an unusual coincidence...

records.jp: そうだよね！　やっぱり日菜子ちゃんも運命だと思うよね！
records.en_original: That's right! So you think it's fate too, Hinako!
records.en_auxiliary: Right?! So you think it's fate too, Hinako!
records.en: Exactly! You think it's fate too, Hinako-chan!

records.jp: （そんなこと言ってないんだけど……）
records.en_original: (I never said that...)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's not exactly what I said.)
records.en: (I didn't say that...)

records.jp: よし！　私、決めた！　今日はダメだったけど<CR>いつか絶対日菜子ちゃんをものにして見せる！
records.en_original: Okay! I've made my decision! Today might have been no good, but I'll definitely make you mine someday!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay! I've made up my mind! Today I may've failed, but I'll definitely make you mine someday!
records.en: Alright! I've decided! It didn't work today,<CR>but someday I'll definitely make you mine, Hinako-chan!
Huh...?

records.jp: 覚悟しといてね日菜子ちゃん！<CR>それじゃ
records.en_original: Prepare yourself, Hinako! See you again.
records.en_auxiliary: Prepare your heart, Hinako! See you soon.
records.en: Prepare yourself, Hinako-chan!<CR>See you!

records.jp: いっちゃった……
records.en_original: She left...
records.en_auxiliary: She left...
records.en: She left...

records.jp: ヒナちゃん、どうするの？<CR>これからもっとすごくなりそうだったけど……
records.en_original: What are you going to do, Hina? I think things are only going to get crazier now...
records.en_auxiliary: What are you going to do, Hina? I think things are only going to get crazier now.
records.en: What will you do, Hina-chan?<CR>It sounded like she was going to get even more intense...

records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh*

records.jp: （でも、しほりの人生を変えたのが良子おばさんだったって<CR>知れたのは嬉しかったかな……）
records.en_original: (But I'm kind of happy to know that Aunt Yoshiko was the one who changed Shihori's life...)
records.en_auxiliary: (But I'm kind of happy to know that Aunt Yoshiko was the one who changed Shihori's life.)
records.en: (Still, I'm glad I learned that Aunt Yoshiko<CR>was the one who changed Shihori's life...)
